lines.text: Art class challenge! The teacher rolled out a giant paper mural across the floor!
Benny the bunny sat guarding his luxury sixty-four crayon box with his paws!
May I borrow sky blue for my river? asked Penny. No, it's mine! Benny snapped!
Benny drew a big blue lake in his corner, but had no green for trees and no yellow for sun!
His picture was dull, while Penny and Leo traded pink, purple, and orange joyfully!
Benny realized: One color alone can never paint a whole vibrant world!
He slid his box to the center: Take whatever colors you need, everyone!
Together they finished the most stunning rainbow forest the school had ever seen!
